description: City staff outlined the planning and development application process.
This included the official community plan and land use changes.

chips.text: Received as information
City plans for growth to accommodate a population of 500,000.

description: Approves multi-sports school at 119 105th Street East.
Allows up to 30 students and 5 staff.
Operates evenings on weekdays, daytime on weekends.

chips.text: Approved
Public notice distributed to nearby residents; no feedback received.

description: Rezones 1224 College Drive to Corridor Station Mixed Use 1.
Allows 3-6 story mixed-use development near transit.

chips.text: Approved
Applicant clarified they did not own the property during previous opt-in.
No public comments or concerns were received on the application.

description: Denies rezoning 133 108th Street West to RM3 District.
Property remains R2 District, allowing four-plexes.
This prevents a six-unit townhouse development.

chips.text: Approved
Administration argued the proposal did not align with infill policies or neighborhood character.
224 property owners within 150 meters were notified and raised concerns.
Administration recommended denial, but three commission members voted against it.
Public expressed concern that approving this application would set a precedent.
Unclear why the applicant did not pursue a rezoning by agreement.
Public concerns included increased traffic, parking, and density.
Three commission members voted against denial

description: Updates city sign rules for digital and construction signs.
Sets new brightness limits for digital signs.
Clarifies sign placement and reduces appeals.

chips.text: Approved
Administration noted common complaints relate to digital sign lighting and separation distances.
Applicants for signs will find regulations easier to understand.
Specific data on bylaw complaints and infractions is tracked but not detailed.
Digital signs near natural areas must be de-energized at night.

description: Chair reported on decisions from January 28, 2026 public hearing.

chips.text: Received as information
Daycare application approved for up to 20 persons and 3 employees.
Administration recommended denying daycare application; Planning Commission recommended approval.
